_comment_business: Branding + locale. Timezone must be a valid PHP timezone (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London').
_comment_logo: Optional local logo path (SVG or PNG). Relative to project root, e.g. 'assets/img/logo.svg'. Used in the admin sidebar and customer pages.
_comment_logo_mode: Sidebar display: 'logo_and_name' shows the logo + the business name; 'logo_only' shows just the logo (full-width, centered).
_comment_mail: mail_driver: 'mail' uses PHP mail(); 'smtp' uses the built-in SMTP client. smtp_encryption: 'tls', 'ssl', or ''.
_comment_slots: Slot grid step in minutes (15 or 30 recommended).
